summary:
Frontend-only end-to-end verification of the NEW 'Call queue (team)' IVR key type on +13346970100 (civr.alice@example.com), plus regression of all other key types + 2-level sub-menu. Every requested flow passes. (A) Initial baseline captured: greeting 'Press 1 for orders, press 2 for our menu by text.', Key 1=forward +14155550100 label 'Orders', Key 2=sms label 'Menu', ivr-enabled-toggle OFF. (B) Queue key added via ivr-add-option-button and action changed to 'queue': all four fields render with the correct testids — ivr-option-2-queue-agents (textarea), -queue-maxwait (number), -queue-overflow (select with exactly the 3 options: 'Play a closing message'/'Take a voicemail'/'Try another phone'), and -queue-announce (checkbox). Typing '+14155550101' <Enter> '+14155550102' character-by-character with 25ms delay produced value exactly '+14155550101
+14155550102' — newline preserved, no characters lost, document.activeElement stayed on the textarea (data-testid='ivr-option-2-queue-agents') throughout. Set longest wait 120, overflow 'voicemail'. Save produced sonner toast 'Saved — flip the switch above to turn the menu on'. After full page reload the row re-read: action='queue', agents='+14155550101
+14155550102', maxwait='120', overflow='voicemail', announce=true. (C) Overflow variants: (i) switching overflow→'forward' with the forward input empty + Save → sonner error 'Key 3: enter the number with country code, e.g. +14155550100.' and no save; (ii) filling -queue-overflow-forward='+14155550100' + Save → 'Saved…' and after reload overflow='forward', fwd='+14155550100'; (iii) switching to 'message' + filling -queue-overflow-message='Sorry we missed you - please try again later.' + Save → 'Saved…' and after reload overflow='message' with the message persisted. (D) Save validation: empty agents → 'Key 3: add at least one phone for the queue to ring.'; 6 phones → 'Key 3: a queue can ring up to 5 phones.'; invalid phone '12' → 'Key 3: enter the number with country code, e.g. +14155550100.' (E) Call flow card: with the queue valid, ivr-flow-tree shows 'Key 3 · Call queue · 2 phones · wait up to 120s · then voicemail'. Clearing agents makes ivr-flow-checks show 'Key 3 — Add at least one phone for the queue to ring (up to 5).'; restoring phones clears it. 'Test my menu' (ivr-flow-test-button) returns '8 passed' and lists these rows verbatim: 'Start · call comes in → plays your greeting and waits for a key', 'Key 1 (Orders) · press 1 → connects the caller to +1 (415) 555-0100', 'Key 2 (Menu) · press 2 → sends the caller a text, then hangs up', 'Key 3 · press 3 → holds the caller with music while 2 phones ring in turn for up to 2 min; if nobody answers, takes a voicemail', 'Key 3 → queue · another caller is already waiting → is told their place in the queue, then waits on hold music', 'Key 3 → queue · caller hangs up while waiting → the ringing stops', 'Any menu · press an unused key → says "invalid option", then asks once more', 'Any menu · press nothing → waits, asks once more, then says goodbye and hangs up'. (F) Inline edit from the flow tree: clicking ivr-flow-node-k3-edit opens ivr-flow-editor containing ivr-flow-edit-queue-agents, -queue-maxwait, -queue-overflow with the same current values; changing maxwait→240 and appending '+14155550103' in the flow-editor textarea was mirrored live to the left builder (ivr-option-2-queue-maxwait='240', ivr-option-2-queue-agents has all three phones on separate lines). (G) Emily (ivr-assist, chat mode): sent 'Key 1 should reach whoever is free on my sales team: +14155550101, +14155550102 and +14155550103. If nobody picks up take a voicemail.' In her FIRST reply (no clarifying question asked) she produced 'SUGGESTED SETUP — Key 1 → queue to +14155550101, +14155550102, +14155550103 with 2-minute max wait, announce position, voicemail if no answer. Key 2 → sms from +12025550111, texts menu links, hangs up. Key 3 removed for clarity.' Clicking 'Fill in the form' (ivr-assist-apply) populated the builder: Key 1 action=queue, agents='+14155550101
+14155550102
+14155550103', overflow='voicemail'; Key 2=sms; no stray key 3. (H) Regressions on Key 3 slot — each saves + persists after reload: forward '+14155550111'; message 'Hello from Bella bakery.'; webhook 'https://example.com/hook'; collect prompt 'Enter your order number' + say-after 'Thanks!'; pin '4821'; pay 'https://buy.stripe.com/test_abc'; 2-level submenu with inner Key 1 forward '+14155550199'. (I) Restore: removed Key 3 via trash button, Saved, Reload — final persisted state verified exactly: greeting 'Press 1 for orders, press 2 for our menu by text.', Key 1=forward +14155550100 label 'Orders', Key 2=sms label 'Menu' (its existing smsText 'Menu: bella.com/menu' and smsFrom mn_ab01 and version B were never touched), ivr-enabled-toggle='false'. Call flow card shows 'Ready to save · No problems found.'
action_items: (Nice-to-have) The queue 'If nobody answers' default when the UI first shows the field is 'Play a closing message' (visible), but the underlying model stores overflow={action:'message'} only after a user interaction; if the user just leaves the default and Saves, the validateIvr branch still works (falls back to 'message'), but consider setting an explicit default on queue key creation so the form state matches exactly what's rendered.

(Nice-to-have) Save error toasts stack in sonner; after a successful save the previous error toast may still be visible for a second or two. Not a bug, just a minor UX note — maybe dismiss stale error toasts on a successful save.
critical_code_review_comments: IvrTab.js queue agents textarea splits on /[\n,;]+/ with trimStart only. If a user pastes a line with a leading comma like ',+1415...' the split yields an empty leading agent that filter(Boolean) in numbers.js drops — fine — but trimStart() keeps trailing whitespace; consider trim() for cleaner persisted array.

IvrTab.js FlowEditor passes the same prefix 'ivr-flow-edit' to ActionFields, so queue textids become ivr-flow-edit-queue-agents etc. (matches spec). However RowHead inside the editor reuses prefix 'ivr-flow-edit' which gives ivr-flow-edit-digit-select / -action-select / -label-input / -remove-button — these testids are shared between the inline editor and any sub-rows if a queue ever gets submenu-like children. Currently queue has no nested children so this is safe.

numbers.js validateIvr queue branch uses /[\s,;]+/ to split when agents is a plain string, which is broader than the UI's /[\n,;]+/. Consider aligning splits so a copy/paste with spaces behaves identically on the server and in the UI.
ivr-blueprint.js 'Test my menu' queue row text is English-only; needs i18n once the app runs in fr/es (same existing comment as prior iterations).

RowHead's digit <select> hides digits already used by siblings — good. But if a queue key is at digit 3 and user changes it to 1 while the queue has sub-widgets (overflow-forward, message), we rely on React keeping state since RowHead is above ActionFields — verified that typing is not lost during digit change in iter_305; still worth a one-line comment.
test_credentials: civr.alice@example.com / AliceTest#2026 at /cloudivr/login (dismiss cookie banner 'Allow all' first). IVR tab: /cloudivr/app/numbers/%2B13346970100?tab=ivr. IVR toggle (ivr-enabled-toggle) was left OFF.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. The number was restored exactly to baseline (greeting + Key 1 forward +14155550100 'Orders' + Key 2 sms 'Menu' with its existing smsFrom/smsText preserved, toggle OFF). Verified post-reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Queue key testids (builder): ivr-option-<i>-queue-agents, -queue-maxwait, -queue-overflow, -queue-overflow-forward (only when overflow='forward'), -queue-overflow-message (only when overflow='message'), -queue-announce. Inline flow editor mirror: ivr-flow-edit-queue-agents / -queue-maxwait / -queue-overflow / -queue-overflow-forward / -queue-overflow-message / -queue-announce. Flow tree node: ivr-flow-node-k<digit> with -edit suffix. Live checks and 'Test my menu' debounce ~500ms — wait ~1.5-2s after a change. Emily chat input testid is ivr-assist-input, send button ivr-assist-send, proposal apply button ivr-assist-apply. Save error toasts: li[data-sonner-toast]. The agents textarea stores value as an array in state but renders as newline-joined string, so typing with Enter correctly reads back value containing '\n' without losing characters or focus.
rca of the issue: No defect reproduced. Queue key is fully functional end-to-end: UI fields render with correct testids, agents textarea preserves newlines and focus during character-by-character typing, all three overflow variants (message / voicemail / forward) render the right secondary input and persist, validation covers empty / >5 / malformed phones and empty overflow-forward, Call flow tree shows correct detail and Test-my-menu lists queue + 'another caller waiting' + 'caller hangs up' rows, the inline editor from the flow tree mirrors the left builder live, and Emily proposes the queue setup in her first reply + applies it correctly. Regression confirmed every other key type (forward/message/webhook/collect/pin/pay/submenu) still saves+reloads after the internal refactor.
